document:
Exercise: Pyramid

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
None

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- static_hold

Primary Muscles:

- lower back

Secondary Muscles:

- shoulders

Equipment:

- exercise_ball

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
3

Energy Requirement:
low to moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- improve_lower_back_flexibility
- strengthen_core_and_stabilizing_muscles

Contraindications:

- lower back pain
- shoulder instability

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:
None

Instructions:

- Start off by rolling your torso forward onto the ball so your hips rest on top of the ball and become the highest point of your body.
- Rest your hands and feet on the floor. Your arms and legs can be slightly bent or straight, depending on the size of the ball, your flexibility, and the length of your limbs. This also helps develop stabilizing strength in your torso and shoulders.
